km is null: the dataset has no distance and line length is not a walking distance
status is a location match against DOC Tracks segments (>=60% of a segment within about 200 m of the walk line); the live DOC notice takes precedence
island uses a coordinate rule: north if lat > -40.4, or lon >= 174.4 and lat > -41.7
